title: Yucong, the Twisted Puppet (No. 34) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Yucong, the Twisted Puppet (No. 34) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Yucong, the Twisted Puppet (No. 34) is an optional rematch encounter in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest, found at Returns later in the story. Beating it yields Freezing Chaos.

sections.title: Where to Find the Yucong, the Twisted Puppet (No. 34)
sections.content:
Location: Returns later in the story.

Appears in: Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is an optional rematch: the same moveset at a higher level, so the first meeting is the rehearsal.

sections.title: How to Beat the Yucong, the Twisted Puppet (No. 34)

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 15 of 60 in the progression order, in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest. Before it: Jade Dancer and Iron Fiend. After it: Zhuo Bi, the Gatekeeper. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
